indicators.title: feat(lab): volume indicators (OBV, CMF, Chaikin, MFI, VWAP, anchored VWAP)

indicators.name: rel_volume
indicators.about: Today's volume over its rolling mean (1 = normal).

indicators.name: obv_trend
indicators.about: On-balance volume over length bars as a share of all volume: +1 = every bar up, -1 = every bar down.

indicators.name: cmf
indicators.about: Chaikin money flow, -1 to +1: volume-weighted closing position within each day's range.

indicators.name: chaikin_osc
indicators.about: Chaikin oscillator: fast EMA minus slow EMA of the A/D line, in units of average daily volume.

indicators.name: mfi
indicators.about: Money flow index, 0-100: a volume-weighted RSI of the typical price.

indicators.name: vwap_dist
indicators.about: Close vs the rolling length-day VWAP of typical price (0.02 = 2% above).

indicators.name: avwap_high_dist
indicators.about: Close vs the VWAP anchored at the highest high of the last length bars (0.02 = 2% above).

indicators.name: avwap_low_dist
indicators.about: Close vs the VWAP anchored at the lowest low of the last length bars (-0.02 = 2% below).

indicators.name: volume_osc
indicators.about: Volume oscillator: fast over slow average volume, minus 1 (0.5 = volume running 50% above normal).

indicators.summary: Adds 8 volume indicators to the strategy lab, so the inventor bots start with roughly the volume studies a charting tool like TrendSpider offers. Before this, the lab had only `rel_volume` and the raw `volume` field. Sabastian asked for this. | Indicator | What it is | Range | |---|---|---| | `obv_trend(length)` | On-balance volume over n bars as a share of total volume | -1 to +1 | | `cmf(length)` | Chaikin money flow | -1 to +1 | | `chaikin_osc(fast, slow)` | Chaikin oscillator (EMA difference of the A/D line), in units of average daily volume | unbounded, 0 = neutral | | `mfi(length)` | Mo…
